title: Comment color is modeled, rendered, and exported — but there is no way to change it
existing_state: CommentNodeData declares color (FlowCanvas/src/nodes/CommentNode.tsx:15), the node renders it as the card background (CommentNode.tsx:37, 96), and export ships it to C# with the DEFAULT_COMMENT_COLOR fallback (utils/exportGraph.ts:127). Yet the comment Properties pane offers only Text and Kind (panels/CommentProperties.tsx:11-37) — no color control anywhere, so every sticky/comment is permanently the default yellow unless the value arrived from import.
recommendation: Add a small swatch row to CommentProperties.tsx (6-8 preset colors drawn from the token palette plus the default), calling the existing updateComment(nodeId, { color }) — the same store path Text/Kind already use. A native color input works too but presets keep stickies on-palette.
user_benefit: Color-coding stickies (red = TODO/danger, green = verified, blue = info) is the whole point of stickies when annotating a large preset; right now the data model supports it but users can't reach it.

evidence.note: color is modeled and rendered as the card background

mockup_idea: Comment properties pane with a 'Color' row of 7 round swatches under the Kind dropdown, and a canvas snippet of three stickies in yellow/red/green annotating different branches.
